description: This file defines an interface class IHealthcheckService for health check operations within the rialto server manager's common namespace. It declares virtual methods for handling ping sent, acknowledgment received, and server removal events.
external_methods: virtual void onPingSent(int serverId, int pingId)
virtual void onAckReceived(int serverId, int pingId, bool success)

classes.name: IHealthcheckService
classes.description: Interface class for health check services, providing virtual methods to handle ping, acknowledgment, and server removal events.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a ping is sent to a server.

methods.name: onAckReceived
methods.description: Handles the acknowledgment received from a server, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: onServerRemoved
methods.description: Handles the event when a server is removed.
